name: en-scored-pronunciation
about: An English lesson with audio pronunciation scores; a pronunciation finding must name a scored weak word and sit on its timestamp, never on spelling.

utterances.speaker: teacher
utterances.text: Tell me about your week, Mateo.

utterances.speaker: student
utterances.text: This week I worked a lot and I thought about the project every day.

utterances.speaker: teacher
utterances.text: Good. What was the hardest part?

utterances.speaker: student
utterances.text: The hardest part was the schedule, because three people were sick.

utterances.speaker: teacher
utterances.text: Say that word again for me — schedule.

utterances.speaker: student
utterances.text: Schedule. It is difficult with the th sound too, like thought.
